name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: Ingrid accepts the invitation and tells him she can meet for coffee after the final session.
reason: She has already treated him as a serious potential partner through months of detailed email exchanges, and her past pattern is to make exceptions for one-on-one business meetings when they could be time-sensitive. The remembered missed opportunity also makes her more likely to take the chance now, while still staying within her narrow evening window.
